protocol.hypothesis: 24of86 standardcost exits expire at onehour. Longer intraday clocks may allow original1.5R/2R targets without changing entries/stops/risk; they may also increase reversals/occupancy and losses.
protocol.selection: One finite development screen, then freeze one diagnostic lead before later outcomes. Require>=30portfolio trades EACHcost, positive net,quoteDD<10 EACHcost, standard/higher net>=sameperiod control. Rank minimum acrosscosts of net / max(1,DDpercent). Failed screens preserved; if no eligible,rank diagnostic lead but never promote. No parameter refit or extra profiles after outcomes.
protocol.expiry: Original actual observed entry+60minutes stays reference. Changed lane uses actual observed entry+90/120minutes, capped16:00NY. Only time exit changes. Target, initialstop, entry features, entrywindows and riskcontroller stayfixed.
protocol.prior_study: spx15_holding_duration_v1 used500USD, older10-12entryrules/1.5R and developmentonly. This is a distinct5000USD shared1.5R/2R composition; not independent price evidence.
